### Findings
Item counts for 'Complete' and 'Returned' statuses by brand within authorized product scope [q1]:

| brand | complete_items | returned_items |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| South | 7 | 1 |
| West | 7 | 1 |

- Both brand "South" and brand "West" reflect identical observed volumes: 7 completed items and 1 returned item [q1].
- Note that these counts reflect a small sample size (8 total items per brand across these two statuses) and should not be taken as established demand or baseline return rates.

### Limitations
- Scope is confined to items with status 'Complete' or 'Returned' within authorized products [q1]; other statuses (e.g., 'Shipped', 'Processing', 'Cancelled') were not queried.
- Item creation dates were not queried, so temporal distribution and historical coverage/completeness were not measured.
- Order-level counts, distinct customer counts, pricing, and financial metrics such as net profit were not included in the query.

### Action items (proposed)
- Query all item statuses across available time buckets to evaluate total volume and observe status distribution over time.
- Propose breaking down item counts and return counts by specific product IDs or categories to evaluate item-level variation.
- Examine customer or order-level metrics to check whether returns are associated with specific repeat patterns or single orders.
